fusions.name: Snapped Napkin
fusions.desc: Snaps a strip of cloth that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and wraps the target so it moves 20% slower for 2 seconds. You heal for 12% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pulled Tablecloth
fusions.desc: Whips a cone 5 tiles long ahead of you that deals 26 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Leaden] for 6 seconds. When it hits, you and every ally deal 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Picnic Blanket
fusions.desc: Lays a cloth where you stand for 10 seconds that restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles of it. Each ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Knotted Kerchief
fusions.desc: When your health falls below half, healing you receive rises by 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
